title: Normanton on Soar - Bomber crash
memorial_details: Rectangular sectioned stone pillar set into the ground incorporating a sloping top face onto which, is mounted an engraved rectangular metal plaque. Black text. (Although the inscription does not state the type of aircraft, other records signify a Wellington Bomber MF200 of 28 OTU Squadron).
inscription: A memorial to the men who lost their lives / In the 19th April 1944 Bomber Crash at / Normanton on Soar / (4 Names)
